name: file.info
title: Size, directory flag, mode, and times

origin.description: The first six file.info columns: size, isdir, mode, mtime, ctime, and atime.

arguments.name: extra_cols
arguments.text: Kept for the base signature. Size, isdir, mode, and the three times are always filled.

origin.details: extra_cols true is the full record. The comparison uses size, isdir, the permission bits, and mtime of R's COPYING file. mode is the integer 420 for octal 644.

translation.description: The first six file.info columns: size, isdir, mode, mtime, ctime, and atime.

arguments.name: extra_cols
arguments.text: Kept for the base signature. Size, isdir, mode, and the three times are always filled.

translation.details: extra_cols true is the full record. The comparison uses size, isdir, the permission bits, and mtime of R's COPYING file. mode is the integer 420 for octal 644.
translation.example:
info = file_info("/usr/lib/R/COPYING", extra_cols=False)[0]
print([info.size, info.isdir, info.mode, int(info.mtime)])
